provenance.operatorDescription: Removes court-centre fields in the combinations the legacy fixtures actually exhibit, plus the complete one.
provenance.operatorRationale: The court centre is read by three different consumers and each fails differently: `code` is the ONLY subscription match key (SubscriptionsService.matchCourtHouse) AND the tail of the file name, `name` is hearingVenue.courtHouse which the frozen contract REQUIRES, and `address` is the venue address block whose absence the mapper answers with undefined. Every court-register fixture in `$DF` except one carries an id and an LJA and nothing else, which is why courtHouse has never once been populated in a legacy test and why the venue address mapper has never executed. This operator makes that state of affairs a case rather than a footnote. Dropping `name` is SCHEMA_INVALID because courtCentre.json requires it — and it is nevertheless the shape most of the legacy fixtures are in.

operatorDetail.why: the hearing block loses its court room
